overall: The AG found the Wayland School Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by posting an insufficiently specific notice for its November 15 meeting, because bare policy codes without context would not be understood by the public, even though full policy texts were posted online.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the November 15 meeting notice's policy-code topics (Policy IGA/IGD, IMG, EFE, IE/IGD) were too vague for the public to understand what would be discussed.
allegations.key_passage: Here, the meeting notice should have identified the nature of the listed policies or otherwise included detail regarding the policies to be discussed.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
remedy_passage: We order the Committee’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and caution the Committee that a determination by our office of a similar violation in the future may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Open Meeting Law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
